title: SwiftSteed
description: SwiftSteed is a lightweight, performance-optimized Fabric modpack that enhances the vanilla experience without altering its core mechanics.
body:
---

## 🧩 What is StarCraft?

> 🧬 A performance-enhanced, quality-of-life focused Fabric modpack that stays faithful to vanilla Minecraft. No tech/magic overhauls — just a smoother, richer vanilla experience.

🌟 Designed for players who want modern features, better visuals, and zero lag — while keeping the vanilla feel.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

### ⚡ Performance Enhancements
- 🧠 `Sodium` + `Lithium` + `Starlight`: Maximize FPS and stability
- 🌐 `Concurrent Chunk Management Engine`: Smoother chunk loading with multithreading
- 🪙 `Clumps`, `Cull Leaves`, `Entity Culling`: Reduce lag from mobs and transparent blocks

### 🏗️ Visuals & Building Utilities
- 🖼️ `Enhanced Block Entities`: High-quality rendering for signs and item frames
- 🎛️ `Sodium Extra` + `Reese's Options`: Full control over video settings
- 🧱 `MiniHUD`, `Item Scroller`: Building support and inventory QoL

### 🔌 Redstone & Survival Tools
- 🧪 `Carpet` series: Customize and debug vanilla behavior deeply
- 🧾 `Jade`, `WTHIT`: Block/entity info tooltips
- 🖥️ `Modern UI`, `ToastLib`: Clean and modern GUI upgrades

### 🧰 QOL Improvements
- 🔁 `In-Game Account Switcher`: Instant account switching
- 💬 `No Chat Reports`, `Chat History`, `Mod Menu`: Safer social experience, better accessibility
- 🛠️ `Fast Renamer`, `ServerCore`, `ItemScroller`: Admin-grade utilities

---

## 🎮 Playstyle Suggestions

| Style | Why it works |
|-------|--------------|
| 🏠 Builders | Visual aids + HUD + smoother frame rate |
| ⚙️ Redstoners | Carpet suite, TPS stabilizers, display tools |
| 🛡️ Tech farms | Lag-free chunk loading and redstone helpers |
| 🌍 Multiplayer | Server-friendly, no chat reports, anti-crash |
| 🧘 Solo play | Lightweight, runs smooth even on low-end PCs |

---

## 📦 Tech Info

- 🔧 **Platform**: Fabric 1.21.4
- 📦 **Mods**: 70+ (performance/QoL only)
- 💻 **Min Spec**: Dual-core CPU / 4GB RAM (6GB+ recommended)
- 🌐 **Server Support**: Fully multiplayer compatible

---

## 🧭 Who is SwiftSteed for?

**SwiftSteed: Vanilla Unbridled** is ideal for:

- 🧱 **Builders** who want smoother gameplay and better visual aids without bulky mods.
- ⚙️ **Redstone engineers** who need a lag-free, debug-friendly environment.
- 🧑‍💻 **Server admins** running lightweight multiplayer servers with enhanced stability and safety.
- 🌾 **Survival players** seeking minor but meaningful quality-of-life improvements.
- 💻 **Low-spec users** who want better FPS without sacrificing vanilla mechanics.
- 🎮 **Vanilla purists** who want modern convenience, not gameplay changes.

---

## 🖥️ Setup Recommendations

- ✅ Use Grallvm JDK for best experience
- 🔌 JDK 21 or later version
- 🧩 Suggested Addons: Complementary Shaders + Faithful / VanillaTweaks

---

---

## 📢 Tip

This pack enhances vanilla gameplay without adding complex tech/magic mods. Perfect for players who love the original game and just want smoother, smarter, prettier Minecraft.
